youtube.title: Agar Aap Dharti ke Beech Ke Hole Mein Gir Jaayein To Kya Hoga? 🌍 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Socho Dharti ke aar-paar ek seedha hole hai, aur aap usme kood jaate ho. Gravity aapko neeche kheenchti hai, tezi se, centre ki taraf. Centre par aapki speed hazaaron kilometre per hour hoti hai.

Phir gravity aapko wapas kheenchne lagti hai, aur upar jaate waqt aap dheere ho jaate ho. Sabse simple version mein, aap lagbhag chalis minute mein doosri taraf nikal aate ho. Aur phir waapas gir jaate ho. Hamesha ke liye. Jab tak koi aapko pakad na le.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
